items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: And Philly Ray used to play bass. We used to get on the lake and buck out there.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, not the young man today that plays trumpet. Yeah.

One played trumpet and one used to play the bass. And Philly Ray used to play bass. We used to get on the lake and buck out there. The camps would be right there, side and side. We used to get there and blow at each other. Dixon Land.
You're talking about humpback Gallaty though. Yeah.
